methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); home-improvement retail signals

pit_profile.why: Lowe's: the world's second largest home improvement retailer, 1,977 home improvement and hardware stores in the U.S. and Canada with approximately 208 million square feet, serving do-it-yourself, do-it-for-me and professional customers; its sales follow housing turnover and the activity level of home improvement projects (its own 10-K), the franchise does not

theme_watch.reason: Live: Lowe's own FY2019 10-K says 'We face growing competition from online and omni-channel retailers who have a similar product or service offering. Customers are increasingly able to quickly comparison shop and determine real-time product availability and price using digital tools. Further, online and omni-channel retailers continue to focus on delivery services, as customers are increasingly seeking faster, guaranteed delivery times and low-price or free shipping, and we must make investments to keep up with our customers’ evolving shopping preferences.' At the same time it sells online itself: 'For purchases made on Lowes.com, customers may pick up their purchase in-store, have their purchase delivered from a store, or have their purchase parcel shipped.'. The stock trades at 19.4x FY21E — near its own median. Re-file as DISRUPTION_EXPOSED (ECOMMERCE) only if dated evidence shows the market pricing online substitution of Lowe's store sales specifically.

classification.quality_note: Lowe's: the world's second largest home improvement retailer, 1,977 home improvement and hardware stores in the U.S. and Canada with approximately 208 million square feet, serving do-it-yourself, do-it-for-me and professional customers; its sales follow housing turnover and the activity level of home improvement projects (its own 10-K), the franchise does not. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 0.20x; +21% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +1.39; conservative 2yr +63%.

BEAR.desc: Flat EPS (worst year FY10-FY20, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +33.2%/yr (Q4 FY20 sales + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +33.2%/yr (FY10-FY20 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +33.2%/yr (best 2-yr run FY10-FY20); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: LOW (retrospective, 2021-03-12) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.20x (17.2% downside to Bear $142 / +86.5% upside to Bull $320) | Adj composite 2.97 vs market 1.58: gap +1.39 [UNDERVALUED] | +21% above the EPP floor $142 (16x FY21E $8.86) | Conservative 2-yr case: +62.8% total (+31.4%/yr) | At 19.4x FY21E the 15% hurdle price $227 sits at or below the BASE case; comps +28.1% in Q4 FY20, forward sales +26.7% (no FY21 sales guide, Q4 FY20 sales); e-commerce competition is live and company-acknowledged; no dated evidence ties the multiple to it.
